browser: Google Chrome 155.0.8059.39, Linux, headless, isolated profile
scope: Production web builds using fixture API responses, 120 synthetic bookmarks in 12 expanded groups. No user data or production server access.
measurement: CDP Performance TaskDuration delta / Timestamp delta over a 5 second idle window after 1.5 seconds settling. Main-thread busy percentage, not an OS whole-machine CPU measurement.
root_cause: snapshotDisplay returned networkProbe before clickOpenTarget; Zod snapshot parsing reordered the same values. JSON.stringify comparison in useSystemConfig therefore always detected a change. updateBookmarkPresentation unconditionally wrote and notified, triggering the same effect again.
changes: Normalize display projection through the same schema used by stored snapshots.
Skip presentation writes and notifications when normalized contents are identical.
Publish when server config changes or a cache becomes available; do not republish stale server-query data in response to another cache notification.

regressions.before: All three new regression tests failed on the old implementation, including a bounded hook reproduction with 24 write attempts.
regressions.after: 66 test files, 399 tests passed. ESLint, web/server build and Chrome extension build passed. Existing Vite chunk-size warnings remain.
coverage: Display serialization stable after validated storage round trip
No duplicate writes/notifications for equivalent display or expansion values
Real display/expansion changes persist and notify
Multiple useSystemConfig consumers settle without repeated writes
Newer cached settings from another tab are not overwritten by a stale query
Search filters 120 fixture cards down to 11 matching cards

limitations: No direct profiling of the affected Mac
At measurement time: no production deployment, release, extension store upload, or source push. Subsequent publication is tracked by the v1.4.28 release.
Packaged extension built and covered by automated tests; CPU comparison is for the web build
